_how_to_use: Each language below lists the texts it is still missing, written in English. Replace every English value with its translation into that language and keep the keys exactly as they are. Keep product names as they are (DLSS 5, ReShade, OptiScaler, RenoDX, Multipass, MFG, FLOW MFG, FPS, DirectX, Vulkan, RTX 40...), and keep symbols such as ·, …, -, % and line breaks. Then send this file back to be merged into languages.JSON.

fa - Persian.lf_flow_mode_hint: Performance draws the frames in between lightly, as Lossless Scaling's performance mode does: FLOW MFG then takes a fraction of the graphics card's time (at 1440p on an RTX 3060, x4 at 60 real FPS: about a quarter of the card instead of more than half), so the game loses far fewer frames and nothing queues up into lag. Quality is the full drawing: small fast objects and the edges between moving things come out better, for much more of the card.
fa - Persian.lf_fg_queue_hint: How DLSS MFG times its frames, like Queue target in Lossless Scaling. Every frame is shown the same short time after the moment of the game it stands for; this sets how much room that time leaves for a frame that arrives late. 0: least delay, a frame may come late now and then. 1: balanced. 2: smoothest, a little more delay.
fa - Persian.lf_select_window_hint: Press it, then click the game: it is taken at once and fills the screen, the way Lossless Scaling does it.
fa - Persian.lf_fg_resolution_hint: The size DLSS MFG makes its frames at. Smaller is lighter on the card; the game's own frames keep their size.
fa - Persian.lf_color_space_hint: How the picture is handed to the screen. Auto: the HDR switch beside it decides. sRGB: 8 bits, ordinary SDR - also on an HDR screen. sRGB Linear: half float, linear light, SDR range. scRGB: half float; HDR is kept when the screen is in HDR. Changing it restarts the worker (about a second). With a generator on, the linear output goes out as sRGB.
fa - Persian.lf_hdr_switch_hint: Keeps HDR all the way to the output when Windows HDR is on. It decides while Color space is on Auto.
fa - Persian.lf_keep_colors_hint: How much of the picture's own color DLSS 5 leaves alone. At 100% the network changes light and detail only; lower lets its own coloring through.
fa - Persian.lf_low_light_hint: Smooths the noise in dark parts of the picture, edges kept. 0% = off.
fa - Persian.lf_shortcut_hint_record: Starts recording what LIVE FLOW shows into your capture folder, and stops it, without leaving the game. Works while LIVE FLOW is the open section.
fa - Persian.storage_hint: Picture caches, logs, and backups that no installed mod needs any more. Your settings and the original files of modded games are kept.
fa - Persian.lf_nr_model_hint: Quality is NVIDIA's model A: the sharper picture, at about twice the cost of B. Fast is the smaller model B. Changing it starts LIVE FLOW again.
fa - Persian.lf_window_pick_hint: Off: DLSS 5 and MFG work on the whole screen. On: the Select window button at the top picks one window, and both work on it.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_missing: The MFG engine is missing from "mod files". Install DLSS 5 MANAGER again.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_preset_c_warning: Not recommended. Preset C lowers the image quality a lot, and the performance you gain from it is small.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_game_fps_help: The game's own frame rate. On Auto it is read from the frames; pick your game's rate if the frame rate shown jumps around with what you do in the game.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_required: The MFG engine (version {0}) has to be downloaded once.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_update: A newer engine is available: version {0}
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_failed: The engine could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
fa - Persian.lf_smfg_unavailable: This generator is not available on this device.
fa - Persian.lf_msm_waiting: Waiting - press START MOTION in MFG SUPER MOTION
fa - Persian.lf_shortcut_hint_shot: Saves a picture of what LIVE FLOW shows into your capture folder without leaving the game. Works while LIVE FLOW is the open section.
fa - Persian.dll_name_desc: The name OptiScaler, ReShade or the AMD payload is loaded as. The install picks it automatically - change it only if the game or another tool needs a different one.

it - Italian.lf_shortcut_hint_record: Starts recording what LIVE FLOW shows into your capture folder, and stops it, without leaving the game. Works while LIVE FLOW is the open section.
it - Italian.storage_hint: Picture caches, logs, and backups that no installed mod needs any more. Your settings and the original files of modded games are kept.
it - Italian.lf_nr_model_hint: Quality is NVIDIA's model A: the sharper picture, at about twice the cost of B. Fast is the smaller model B. Changing it starts LIVE FLOW again.
it - Italian.lf_window_pick_hint: Off: DLSS 5 and MFG work on the whole screen. On: the Select window button at the top picks one window, and both work on it.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_missing: The MFG engine is missing from "mod files". Install DLSS 5 MANAGER again.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_preset_c_warning: Not recommended. Preset C lowers the image quality a lot, and the performance you gain from it is small.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_game_fps_help: The game's own frame rate. On Auto it is read from the frames; pick your game's rate if the frame rate shown jumps around with what you do in the game.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_required: The MFG engine (version {0}) has to be downloaded once.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_update: A newer engine is available: version {0}
it - Italian.lf_smfg_failed: The engine could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
it - Italian.lf_smfg_unavailable: This generator is not available on this device.
it - Italian.lf_msm_waiting: Waiting - press START MOTION in MFG SUPER MOTION

pt - Portuguese.lf_flow_mode_hint: Performance draws the frames in between lightly, as Lossless Scaling's performance mode does: FLOW MFG then takes a fraction of the graphics card's time (at 1440p on an RTX 3060, x4 at 60 real FPS: about a quarter of the card instead of more than half), so the game loses far fewer frames and nothing queues up into lag. Quality is the full drawing: small fast objects and the edges between moving things come out better, for much more of the card.
pt - Portuguese.lf_fg_queue_hint: How DLSS MFG times its frames, like Queue target in Lossless Scaling. Every frame is shown the same short time after the moment of the game it stands for; this sets how much room that time leaves for a frame that arrives late. 0: least delay, a frame may come late now and then. 1: balanced. 2: smoothest, a little more delay.
pt - Portuguese.lf_select_window_hint: Press it, then click the game: it is taken at once and fills the screen, the way Lossless Scaling does it.
pt - Portuguese.lf_fg_resolution_hint: The size DLSS MFG makes its frames at. Smaller is lighter on the card; the game's own frames keep their size.
pt - Portuguese.lf_color_space_hint: How the picture is handed to the screen. Auto: the HDR switch beside it decides. sRGB: 8 bits, ordinary SDR - also on an HDR screen. sRGB Linear: half float, linear light, SDR range. scRGB: half float; HDR is kept when the screen is in HDR. Changing it restarts the worker (about a second). With a generator on, the linear output goes out as sRGB.
pt - Portuguese.lf_hdr_switch_hint: Keeps HDR all the way to the output when Windows HDR is on. It decides while Color space is on Auto.
